ptolemy.claim: Place of occourse or occident is selected through earlier length-of-life mechanism; occupants then conditional approaching fallback.

rhetorius.claim: Eighth-house rulership and additional Lots/DSC term-ruler routes appear, with an expressly alternative Critodemus attribution.

comparisons.operational_consequence: Keep author/method labels; ruler of eighth cannot automatically become Ptolemy IV.9 primary carrier. No mortality validity follows.

comparisons.topic: Term-system provenance inside a copied method

ptolemy.chapter: IV.9 and prior I term-table audit
ptolemy.claim: Uses nature of terms and cross-references earlier terms material; prior tables preserved.

rhetorius.claim: Holden says the referenced Critodemus terms included Sun; identifies an alternative source within the compilation.

comparisons.operational_consequence: Same technical term does not authorize substitution of a different table. A complete Critodemus table is not supplied by this note. Rhetorius57/77 duplication is not independent evidence.

comparisons.topic: Type, severity and publicity need separate modifiers

ptolemy.claim: Separates affliction, magnitude, quality; qualified afflicted-Jupiter testimony can add conspicuous public circumstances.

rhetorius.claim: With eighth house and ruler ill situated, benefic aspect to either yields same kinds of deaths but not public; a different only-benefics/no-malefics clause says peaceful.

comparisons.operational_consequence: Do not collapse mitigation into prevention or compare clauses with different antecedents as a contradiction. Do not interpret generic Jupiter presence as protection.
